rules.message: A polling nav fragment must target itself (data-hx-target="this") — the polling attributes travel with the fragment, so the server owns the cadence.
A polling nav fragment must swap outerHTML — innerHTML strands the old trigger on the surviving element and it polls forever.
The fragment needs an id — it is the anchor every out-of-band correction (mark-read responses) swaps against.
The accessible name (aria-label with the count) belongs on the nav item — the badge is presentation, and name + count must change in the same swap.
Mark the badge aria-hidden="true" — the count a screen reader gets is the nav item's accessible name, not the badge text.
The fragment must not be a live region — a chrome count announcing every poll interrupts screen-reader users mid-task. Arrivals that deserve announcement are the event's own toast.
